notes: The exact W1.A05.S01 R01 integration submission is approved with no blocking or nonblocking acceptance-bound finding. Product candidate 3f91f7721e293b72d8367e1036c5875dc1f14ff2 is a strict ancestor of all-task-approved state 568742a1b4deecb6a630a3d218f5d624d95b7278, which is a strict ancestor of submission 0b011eebfd2d060e981301c5d1ad0c2e0a467bd5. The submission adds only the immutable integration packet to the approved state. The packet reproduces SHA-256 b4091a067fc1d0b4c17a871acfd23f7d77d4339e94639b5d9631db2ad98a0e03 and Git blob d62920a28c4891099c2ef9d357dc1f7824cdbfb8. Both tasks are DONE with approved final ledgers, and their four final evidence/review files reproduce the packet's hashes. Independent union replay confirms the native supervisor remains the only unlock authority. The password adapter retains its non-persisting CredUI prompt, LogonUserW proof, submitted-token/current-process EqualSid comparison, volatile secret clearing, and handle cleanup. The Hello adapter uses the desktop HWND-bound IUserConsentVerifierInterop operation under a balanced WinRT apartment, retains the operation until completion, and maps only Verified to succeeded. No Hello path accepts or captures a renderer provider/outcome/window, PIN, biometric, username, password, or token, and no Hello failure invokes password or no-login fallback. The common manager reserves one current locked generation before provider invocation, admits only one attempt, applies denial backoff, rejects stale/replayed success, starts Core only after native success, rechecks generation after Core start, stops a raced or failed Core, and clears reservations after cancellation, failure, and panic. Renderer decoders require exact own data properties and primitive closed values, invoke no accessors, reconstruct trusted snapshots, and allow only the exact native succeeded/unlocked tuple to clear fail-closed reconciliation. Availability, unlock, recovery, and lock commands remain argument-free across the authority boundary; same-SID password recovery is separate and is not invoked by Hello. The direct Windows dependency versions are exact, Windows-only, and already present through the Tauri/WebView graph. The real release-authoritative Windows probe independently returned not-present, so this review does not infer configured interactive success from injected tests. That conditional hardware proof remains explicit, while T03 retains persisted provider selection and transition authority, T04 retains the governed deliberate recovery/settings/accessibility experience, and complete cross-capability qualification remains due at W1 exit.
